VERDICT: KEEP
WHY: The core invariant — ephemeral chairs commit signed vouchers to the Ledger/CAS and destroy their keys, so persistence derives solely from committed artifacts — is a buildable, chair-death-tolerant principle worth percolating despite the truncated verification logic. It's a design pattern, not yet a shippable build, and the cutoff leaves the falsifiable test incomplete.
TAGS: ephemeral-identity, ledger-vouchers, cas-persistence
